svg.title: The Ranger's Book: Ledger in graphite
svg.desc: The Ranger's Book (1D): the ranger's logbook open across the page, ruled in columns and worked in graphite. The check-in rows have closed up where lost sites were, and the permit numbers skip. On the right, the day's totals say 12 sites and 35 persons while Tam's pencil sums reach 9 and 26; a dashed ghost row is being dragged into the gap after site 1, filled from the shortfall.
